name: Spider 2.0
intro: Spider 2.0 是一个包含632个真实企业级数据库文本转SQL工作流问题的评测框架。数据库来自实际应用，常含1000多列，存储于本地或云端如BigQuery和Snowflake。挑战要求模型处理复杂SQL环境、长上下文、多条SQL语句及复杂推理，远超传统文本转SQL任务。
org: xlang.ai, The University of Hong Kong, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory,
eval_feature: 长文本, 多轮, 领域特定
intro_en: Spider 2.0 is a benchmark consisting of 632 real-world enterprise-level database text-to-SQL workflow problems. The databases originate from practical applications, often containing over 1,000 columns, stored locally or in the cloud such as BigQuery and Snowflake. The challenge requires models to handle complex SQL environments, long contexts, multiple SQL statements, and intricate reasoning, far exceeding traditional text-to-SQL tasks.
scale_en: 632 agentic workflows; 547 tasks each in Lite and Snow
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.07763v2 and the official Spider 2.0 repository. Source material spans 213 enterprise databases and a candidate pool of 1,021 complex SQL queries plus 157 DBT projects; 547 SQL queries and 78 DBT projects are retained only after successful, timely, non-empty execution. Those retained source artifacts are not presented as an arithmetic derivation of the 632 released agentic workflows. To reduce contamination, 84.2% receive surface rewrites and 42.0% semantic rewrites, followed by re-execution. Tasks bundle dialect documentation, database interfaces, codebase context, and manually verified instructions. Focused string, table, or database evaluators ignore irrelevant columns and are red-teamed; each instruction, gold SQL, and evaluator is reviewed by at least three annotators. Spider 2.0 reports binary Success Rate over 632 agentic workflows, while the 547-task Lite and Snow variants report Execution Accuracy.
